subject: ADR-180: the figures beside the controls -- the readable audit reads an entry host by what remains once its widgets are removed; 42 more elements measured, the survey's event tree a box held byte for byte, every ceiling 0
body: ADR-146'S HOLE, CLOSED. The readable audit skipped any element holding a control, whole -- so a figure written beside a button (the pheno tracker's ranked run, the scout's per-stop counts and rotation verdicts, the notebook's quadrat counts, the survey's event tree with a copy button per row) was never measured; ADR-171 named it and carried it. The audit now reads such a host by what remains once its controls (data-h, button, input, select, textarea, label, a[href]) and the kit's widget wrappers (.fek-*) are subtracted from a clone, the same subtraction on the baseline: a kit label is not a figure, a count beside a button is, static prose with a link is not written. Written 270 -> 312, six blind. The survey's event tree becomes a box (read-report names tree by its whole id; verify_report 115, mutate_report 69/69, anchor widened); the survey task holds boxes.tree byte for byte, fifteen rows SGH2026:survey:01 to visit:08 (73 -> 74), pinned by verify_sd's port of the example's ID scheme (70 -> 73). Five declared furniture with reasons (pRg, fkq, scorePanel, traitChips, wEditor). Every ceiling 0. verify_readable 37, mutate_readable 33/33 + 1 recorded equivalent. No page was edited.
